cad_evidence.interpretation: User identifies the front cylinder as the lens. The 15 mm diameter circular front face supplies a virtual viewpoint; its axis is 20 degrees below the CAD horizontal.

assumptions: The teacher flight uses a symmetric simplified vehicle, not the static CAD aircraft.
For this preview only, CAD camera-side +Y maps to teacher body -X (the outbound-facing side at initial yaw); CAD bounding-box center maps to teacher body origin.
CAD front-face center is used as a virtual optical center, not a measured entrance pupil or sensor center.
The CAD-to-teacher mapping is not a measured center of mass, flight-controller alignment or real sensor extrinsic calibration.
Pinhole FOV is assumed; no lens distortion, exposure, motion blur, rolling shutter or sensor noise.
